Pipeline invariant checks

Source: R/invariants.R
check_invariants.Rd

Pipeline invariant checks

Usage

check_invariants(
  stage,
  ...,
  strict = TRUE,
  coverage = FALSE,
  coverage_min = 0.9,
  area = FALSE,
  area_baseline_m2 = NULL,
  coverage_baseline_m2 = NULL,
  area_tol_frac = 0.005
)

Arguments

stage

Character. One of "refactored", "reconciled", "aggregated", "ngen".

...

Stage-specific named arguments. For "ngen": flowpaths, divides, nexus, and optionally network (the aspatial network table, used to check flowline_id global uniqueness, flowline_toid referential integrity, and flowline graph acyclicity) and lakes (the waterbody layer, used to check that lake_id stamps intersect their lake).

strict

Logical. If TRUE (default) any failed check throws an error.

coverage

Logical. Run expensive flowpath-in-catchment coverage check.

coverage_min

Minimum fraction of a flowpath inside its catchment.

area

Logical. Run the geometric non-overlap check (computes the union of all network divides: moderately expensive on large VPUs). The cheap total-area, area-conservation, and shared-divide checks always run for stages that carry a divides layer, regardless of this flag.

area_baseline_m2

Numeric. Total area (m2) of the upstream divide set this stage must conserve (typically the sum of the input divides' areas). When supplied, divides_area_conserved asserts the output total stays within area_tol_frac of it. NULL (default) reports the total as info only.

coverage_baseline_m2

Numeric. Union area (m2) of the upstream divide set, i.e. the ground it covers rather than the sum of its parts. When supplied, divides_coverage_conserved reports the change in footprint. This is what detects lost ground: removing an overlap and punching a hole both reduce the summed area, but only a hole reduces the union. Requires area = TRUE, which is when the union is computed.

area_tol_frac

Numeric. Fractional tolerance for the area-conservation and non-overlap checks. Default 0.005 (0.5%).

Value

Invisibly a list with ok, stage, and checks.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
check_invariants("ngen",
                 flowpaths = sf::st_read("ngen_vpu01.gpkg", "flowpaths"),
                 divides   = sf::st_read("ngen_vpu01.gpkg", "divides"),
                 nexus     = sf::st_read("ngen_vpu01.gpkg", "nexus"),
                 strict = FALSE, area = TRUE)
} # }
